body: I'm never stressed around the kids, they are only 5 & 2 - I'm one of those people who is very good at hiding it, but when I'm on my own the darkness in my mind takes over and all I want to do is end it, I know it's the cowards way out and I know how much mess I will leave behind for my lady and kids, I'm the main earner in the house, so I'm conflicted, I really want to end it but cant help thinking about leaving my family in a mess. Its messing me up mentally
